items.example: 今天天气很好，我们在外面吃吧。
items.example_en: The weather's nice today, let's eat outside.
items.note: No verb to be with adjectives; 很 fills the gap.

items.example_en: It's been raining since this morning.
items.note: Literally the rain descends. Same pattern for 下雪.

items.example_en: It's snowing in the mountains.

items.example: 今天早上很冷，穿外套吧。
items.example_en: It's cold this morning, put on a coat.
items.note: 天气很冷 is about the air, 我很冷 about you.

items.example_en: What's the weather like where you are?
items.note: 怎么样 asks how something is, in any context.

items.example_en: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
items.note: The future needs no verb marking; 明天 does the work.

items.example_en: In spring all the flowers bloom.
items.note: All four seasons end in 天: 春天, 夏天, 秋天, 冬天.

items.example_en: In summer we go to the seaside.
items.note: The time word comes before the verb.

items.example_en: This winter we're going to the mountains.
items.note: 里 turns it into a location: 山里, inside the mountains.

items.example_en: The sea is calm today.
items.note: 海边 is the seaside, literally the sea's edge.

items.example: 周日我们在森林里散步。
items.example_en: On Sundays we walk in the forest.
items.note: Both characters are built from 木, tree.

items.example: 气候变化正在改变季节。
items.example_en: Climate change is altering the seasons.
items.note: 正在 marks an ongoing process, more formal than 在.

items.example: 这是我看过三次的电影。
items.example_en: This is a film I've watched three times.
items.note: The relative clause comes BEFORE the noun, with 的.

items.example_en: I like watching films in the original language.
items.note: 配音 means dubbed.

items.example_en: Switch the subtitles to Chinese.
items.note: Chinese TV usually carries Chinese subtitles by default.

items.example: 我开始看一本侦探小说。
items.example_en: I started reading a detective novel.
items.note: 本 is the measure word for books.

items.example_en: The series is long, but it's worth watching.
items.note: 部 is the measure word for films and series.

items.example_en: I really recommend you read this book.
items.note: Fronting 这本书 makes it the topic: a very Chinese move.

items.english: to want to, to feel like
items.example_en: I feel like going out tonight.
items.note: 想 is softer than 要; it also means to think and to miss someone.

items.example_en: I'm going out with friends on Friday.
items.note: 跟 or 和 for with; it comes before the verb.

items.example_en: Photography is my biggest hobby.
items.note: 好 is hào here, meaning to be fond of.

items.example_en: Our gathering went on until three in the morning.
items.note: 到 marks the endpoint.

items.example_en: A film tonight, how about it?
items.note: Tacked on the end, it turns a plan into an invitation.

items.example_en: Where shall we meet, and at what time?
items.note: The place phrase comes before the verb 见.

items.example_en: I think that's a bad idea.
items.note: The everyday opinion opener, softer than 我认为.

items.example: 我认为这个讨论缺乏细节。
items.example_en: I consider this discussion to lack nuance.
items.note: More formal and more committed than 我觉得.

items.example: 在我看来，情况已经变了。
items.example_en: In my view, the situation has already changed.
items.note: A framing phrase at the start of the sentence.

items.example: 我相信这个方法会成功。
items.example_en: I believe this approach will work.
items.note: 会 here marks likelihood, not ability.

items.example: 话虽如此，成本还是个问题。
items.example_en: That said, the cost is still a problem.
items.note: A written-register connector that signals a concession.

items.example: 很贵；另一方面，可以用很多年。
items.example_en: It's expensive; on the other hand, it lasts for years.
items.note: Pairs with 一方面, on the one hand.

items.example: 这一点我同意你的看法。
items.example_en: On this point I agree with your view.
items.note: 同意 takes a direct object, with no preposition.

items.example_en: Honestly, I don't really agree.
items.note: 不太 softens the disagreement, which matters a lot in Chinese.

items.example: 虽然有风险，但是不做也有风险。
items.example_en: Although there is risk, there is also risk in doing nothing.
items.note: Chinese keeps BOTH halves of the pair, unlike English.

items.example: 关于时间安排，我们要现实一点。
items.example_en: We need to be a bit more realistic about the schedule.
items.note: 一点 after an adjective softens it into a suggestion.

items.example: 如果我能选的话，我会做得不一样。
items.example_en: If I could choose, I'd do it differently.
items.note: 如果 opens and 的话 closes the condition; either alone is also fine.

items.english: no matter what, in any case
items.example: 不管怎么样，今天必须决定。
items.example_en: In any case, we have to decide today.
items.note: 不管 plus a question word means regardless of the answer.
